messages:
Ethan Rivera: Putting this thread together  Veridian Health wants to run a POC with a tuned `mistral-8b-clinical` variant. They say it's trained on de-identified clinical transcripts but still need PHI controls. Asks: can we serve their HF checkpoint + LoRA, meet p95 <130ms for short chats (~80 tokens), and give a Dedicated pricing ballpark?
Zara Malik: Ask them for exact artifacts: HF repo vs private S3, and whether tokenizer was modified. Tokenizer differences are common pitfall.
Ethan Rivera: They indicated HF link (private) and a 40MB LoRA on top of our base `mistral-8b`. Will share read-only token after DPA.
Owen Blake: Runtime quick take: Mistral-8b plays well with nf4 on H100 with our kernel set. For p95 <130ms we'd want: H100 preference, small max_sequence (<=512), and an aggressive KV cache strategy. If they plan long contexts, numbers change.
Owen Blake: Recommended smoke config for Dedicated pilot:
```
variant: mistral-8b-clinical-nf4
quant: nf4
hw: h100
max_batch: 6
max_seq: 512
warmers: kv-cache-enabled
fallback: mistral-8b-clinical-8bit
```
Camila Rios: Compliance note: For PHI we require either Private (VPC) deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS + DPA. I'll attach our HIPAA-like checklist. Also need to confirm log retention and whether they require syslog/SIEM integration.
Zara Malik: Ops checklist for SEs to run on repo:
1) tokenizer check: `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --repo veridian/mistral-8b-clinical`
2) adapter verify: `python tools/verify_adapter.py --repo veridian/mistral-8b-clinical --out /tmp/adapter.pt`
3) convert to nf4 (smoke): `python tools/convert_weights.py --in /tmp/adapter.pt --quant nf4`
If any step hits custom operators, post errors here. Those are the usual runtime blockers.
Ethan Rivera: Pricing ask from buyer: they'd like a quick number today to include in the SOW. Can you give a conservative Dedicated estimate and a hosted pilot option?
Camila Rios: Ballpark: hosted private pilot on H100 (on-demand) ~ $8k/mo. Dedicated reserved for stable p95 <130ms at modest scale: 2x H100 reserved ~ $21k/mo. If they insist on A100-only, add ~20% due to less-efficient nf4 fallback. Add +12% for HA and burst capacity.
Owen Blake: Also recommend running an A/B on quality between nf4 and 8-bit on our clinical-eval-01 testset before enabling nf4 for production. Small domain-specific fine-tunes can regress under aggressive quant.
Zara Malik: Security/binaries: ask them for a deps list and any patched attention modules. Use `tar -tf repo.tar.gz | grep -E "\.so$|fused|attn"` to spot compiled libs. Those need security review.
security-bot: ticket SEC-3321 created: "Veridian HF artifact review" assigned to security team.
infra-bot: ticket INF-8124 created: "Veridian  mistral-8b-clinical onboarding + nf4 smoke" assigned to Owen, Zara, Camila.
Ethan Rivera: Action items: (1) I'll collect repo link + expected QPS and sample prompts from buyer (2) Zara runs tokenizer + convert smoke by EOD+1 (3) Owen spins up H100 smoke Dedicated profile and runs latency runs (4) Camila sends DPA/checklist and pricing note.
Camila Rios: I'll also include options for customer-managed KMS and syslog forwarding in the checklist.
Owen Blake: If Zara sees any custom ops, ping me immediately. We may need a rebuild which slows the POC.
Ethan Rivera: Thanks team 604. I'll update the buyer by EOD tomorrow with timelines.
